name: Institutional QMS Custody and Environmental Evidence Reconciliation
objective: Reconcile environmental evidence, sampling custody, QMS/laboratory records and DMRV lineage for disclosure periods without fabricating empirical results.
invariants: sample identity remains stable across custody and QMS
chain of custody does not prove laboratory result validity by itself
QMS readiness is not a result
result provenance must link method/version and source record
batch linkage cannot create a batch where none exists
absence of evidence remains absence, not zero
fail_closed: administrative node substituted for physical evidence
notes: No laboratory or harvest values are created by S10.5. Existing evidence is reconciled only when supplied by controlled empirical operations.
QMS status and laboratory result status remain separate states.
